title: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers Encyclopedia
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー　大事典
summary: The source page treats this as the TV-series bible: poster, scene guide, story digest, character files, the novel 'Flame Awakening', setting materials including early designs, parody manga, cast and staff interviews, goods catalog, and an A-to-Z comic encyclopedia. It is singled out for explaining the armor meetings, ancestry, armors, and sacred treasures in unusual depth.
